dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:8301.text: A woman's illness. Formed from 女, with 卓 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8302.text: To shift responsibility. Formed from 女, with 垂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8303.text: To feel resentment. Formed from 女, with 纴 indicating the sound. People of 汝南 now call feeling resentment 㛴.

shuowen:8304.text: Ashamed. Formed from 女, with 鬼 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8305.text: To quarrel or litigate. Formed from two 女.

shuowen:8306.text: Private or illicit. Formed from three 女.

shuowen:8307.text: A female official. Formed from 女, with abbreviated 牆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8308.text: A woman's name: Daji, consort of Zhou. Formed from 女, with 旦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8309.text: Bearing or manner. Formed from 女, with 喬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8310.text: 嬋娟 means bearing or manner. Formed from 女, with 單 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8311.text: The graceful bearing expressed by 嬋娟. Formed from 女, with 肙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8312.text: Without a husband. Formed from 女, with 𠩺 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8313.text: A mate or encounter. Formed from 女, with 后 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8314.text: To stop or forbid it. Formed from 女 with something violating her. All characters in this group are formed from 毋.

shuowen:8315.text: A person without moral conduct. Formed from 士 and 毋. Palace Attendant Jia says: the First Emperor of Qin's mother committed adultery with Lao Ai, who was executed for it; hence people call a lecher 'Lao Ai' as an insult. Read like 娭.

shuowen:8316.text: The multitude of common people. It follows the ancient-script depiction. All characters in this group are formed from 民.

shuowen:8317.text: The common people. Formed from 民, with 亡 indicating the sound. Read like 盲.

shuowen:8318.text: Turning to the right. It depicts drawing toward the left. All characters in this group are formed from 丿.

shuowen:8319.text: To cut grass. Formed from 丿 and 乀 crossing one another.

shuowen:8320.text: To straighten or correct. Formed from 丿, 乀, and abbreviated 韋.

shuowen:8321.text: Turning to the left. Formed from reversed 丿. Pronounced the same as 弗.

shuowen:8322.text: To draw or pull; bright or manifest. It depicts drawing and pulling. All characters in this group are formed from 𠂆. 虒 is formed from this.

shuowen:8323.text: A stake. It depicts a broken piece of wood, slanting and pointed, fixed in place. Includes 𠂆, depicting something hung upon it.

shuowen:8324.text: To flow. Formed from reversed 𠂆. Read like 移. All characters in this group are formed from 乁.

shuowen:8326.text: In the mountains of Ba and Shu, something attached to the side of a cliff and about to fall is called 氏; when it collapses, it can be heard for hundreds of li. A pictograph, with 乀 indicating the sound. All characters in this group are formed from 氏. Yang Xiong's rhapsody says: 'Resounding like a 氏 collapsing.'

shuowen:8327.text: The root of a tree. Formed from 氏, larger than the tip. Read like 厥.

shuowen:8328.text: To arrive. Formed from 氏 touching 一 below. 一 is the earth. All characters in this group are formed from 氐.

shuowen:8329.text: To lie down. Formed from 氐, with 垔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8330.text: To touch or strike against. Formed from 氐, with 失 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8332.text: A flat-headed halberd. Formed from 弋 crossed by 一; a pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 戈.

shuowen:8333.text: The reigning emperor's tabooed personal name.

shuowen:8334.text: A weapon. Formed from 戈 and 甲.

shuowen:8335.text: The Rites of Zhou says: attending officers hold 戣 and stand at the eastern edge. A weapon. Formed from 戈, with 癸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8336.text: A shield. Formed from 戈, with 旱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8337.text: A branched weapon. Formed from 戈 and 倝. The Rites of Zhou says: 'The 𢧢 is one zhang and six chi long.' Read like 棘.

shuowen:8338.text: A halberd. Formed from 戈 and 𦣻. Read like 棘.

shuowen:8339.text: To ruin. Formed from 戈, with 則 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8340.text: To guard the frontier. Formed from 人 holding 戈.

shuowen:8341.text: To fight. Formed from 戈, with 單 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8342.text: A division of the three armies. Alternatively, a weapon. Formed from 戈, with 䖒 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8343.text: Sharp. Alternatively, to cut or trim. Formed from 戈, with 呈 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8344.text: A state. Formed from 囗 and 戈 to guard 一. 一 is the land.

shuowen:8345.text: To sever. Formed from 戈, with 雀 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8346.text: To kill. Formed from 戈, with 今 indicating the sound. The Book of Shang says: 'The Western Lord has already destroyed Li.'

shuowen:8347.text: To stab with a spear. When a minister from another state comes and kills a ruler, it is called 戕. Formed from 戈, with 爿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8348.text: To kill. Formed from 戈, with 翏 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8349.text: To stab. Formed from 戈, with 甚 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8350.text: A long spear. Formed from 戈, with 寅 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary mentions Dao Yan.

shuowen:8351.text: To injure. Formed from 戈, with 才 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8352.text: To destroy. Formed from 戈, with 晉 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'He truly began to destroy Shang.'

shuowen:8353.text: To cut off. Alternatively, an agricultural implement. Formed from 从 holding 戈. The ancient form is read like 咸. Read like 攕 in the Odes' 'Slender and beautiful are your hands.'

shuowen:8354.text: King Zhuang of Chu says: 'Martial achievement is establishing merit and putting weapons away. Thus stopping 戈 makes 武.'

shuowen:8355.text: To store weapons. Formed from 戈, with 咠 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Then store shields and halberds.'

shuowen:8356.text: The explanation is lacking. Formed from 戈 and 音.

shuowen:8357.text: To harm or ruin. Formed from two 戈. The Book of Zhou says: 'Harmful, crafty words.'

shuowen:8358.text: An axe. Formed from 戈, with 𠄌 indicating the sound. The Methods of the Sima says: 'Xia held a black axe; Yin held a white 戚; Zhou held a yellow axe in the left hand and white yak-tail in the right.' All characters in this group are formed from 戉.

shuowen:8359.text: An axe. Formed from 戉, with 尗 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8360.text: A self-designation applied to oneself. Some explain 我 as bowing or nodding. Formed from 戈 and 𠄒. Some say 𠄒 is ancient 垂; another explanation says it is ancient 殺. All characters in this group are formed from 我.

shuowen:8361.text: One's own dignified bearing. Formed from 我 and 羊.

shuowen:8362.text: An inward-turning hook is called 亅. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 亅. Read like 橜.

shuowen:8363.text: A hooked mark. Formed from reversed 亅. Read like 罬, a bird-catching device.

shuowen:8364.text: To restrain, by a sound gloss. Made by Shennong. Hollow, with openings; five red-dyed silk strings, to which Zhou added two. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 珡.

shuowen:8365.text: A stringed instrument made by Paoxi. Formed from 珡, with 必 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8366.text: 琵琶, a musical instrument. Formed from 珡, with 比 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8367.text: The 琵琶 instrument. Formed from 珡, with 巴 indicating the sound. In this sense 枇杷 should be used.

shuowen:8368.text: To hide. It depicts a curved, concealed shape. All characters in this group are formed from 𠃊. Read like 隱.

shuowen:8369.text: To see straight or correctly. Formed from 𠃊, 十, and 目.

shuowen:8370.text: To flee. Formed from 入 and 𠃊. All characters in this group are formed from 亾.

shuowen:8371.text: To stop. Alternatively, to flee. Formed from 亾 and 一.

shuowen:8372.text: Someone has fled abroad; one hopes for their return. Formed from 亾, with abbreviated 朢 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8373.text: To be absent. Formed from 亾, with 𣞤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8374.text: Breath or vapor. Lu An says: a fugitive is called 匄.

shuowen:8375.text: Slanting and enclosing, with something held hidden inside. Formed from 乚 with 一 covering it above. All characters in this group are formed from 匸. Pronounced the same as 傒.

shuowen:8376.text: 踦區 means to conceal. Formed from 品 within 匸. 品 means a multitude.

shuowen:8377.text: To disappear or hide. Formed from 匸, with 若 indicating the sound. Read like 箠 in 羊騶箠; the reference is obscure.

shuowen:8378.text: To escape sideways. Formed from 匸, with 丙 indicating the sound. Alternatively, a kind of winnowing basket.

shuowen:8379.text: To hide. Formed from 匸, with 妟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8380.text: A container for bow and crossbow arrows. Formed from 匸 and 矢. The Discourses of the States says: 'The soldiers did not loosen their quivers.'

shuowen:8381.text: Four zhang. Formed from 八 and 匸: eight folds make one 匹. 八 also indicates the sound.

shuowen:8382.text: A vessel for receiving things. A pictograph. All characters in this group are formed from 匚. Read like 方.

shuowen:8383.text: A woodworker. Formed from 匚 and 斤. 斤 is what is used to make utensils.

shuowen:8384.text: To store. Formed from 匚, with 夾 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8385.text: A drinking vessel; a basket. Formed from 匚, with 㞷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8386.text: Like a soup ladle, with a channel in its handle for pouring water. Formed from 匚, with 也 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8387.text: A basket for draining rice. Formed from 匚, with 算 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8388.text: A small cup. Formed from 匚, with 𥫔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8389.text: A vessel resembling a bamboo basket. Formed from 匚, with 非 indicating the sound. The Lost Book of Zhou says: 'Place the black and yellow silk in the basket.'

shuowen:8390.text: An ancient vessel. Formed from 匚, with 倉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8391.text: An agricultural implement. Formed from 匚, with 攸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8392.text: An agricultural implement. Formed from 匚, with 異 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8393.text: An ancient vessel. Formed from 匚, with 曶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8394.text: A bowl, a kind of vessel. Formed from 匚, with 俞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8395.text: A chest or box. Formed from 匚, with 貴 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8396.text: A chest. Formed from 匚, with 賣 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8397.text: A chest. Formed from 匚, with 甲 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8398.text: A vessel. Formed from 匚, with 淮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8399.text: A coffin. Formed from 匚 and 木, with 久 indicating the sound.

shuowen:8400.text: A vessel for holding the ancestral tablet in a temple. The Rites of Zhou says: 'For sacrifices, supply the tablet container and tablet.' Formed from 匚, with 單 indicating the sound.
